text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney.

The urinalysis confirms significant hematuria and mild pyuria, while the ultrasound finding of multiple cysts in the medullary collecting ducts is pathognomonic for this condition. Given your history of recurrent UTIs and the absence of obstruction, do you experience flank pain specifically when urinating or after meals?
